response.sql: WITH site_mesh_stats AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat, AVG(sm.facetfaces) as site_avg_faces FROM sites s INNER JOIN scanmesh sm ON s.zoneregistry = sm.zoneref WHERE sm.facetfaces IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat), status_group_averages AS (SELECT entrystat, AVG(site_avg_faces) as status_avg_faces FROM site_mesh_stats WHERE entrystat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY entrystat), overall_average_calc AS (SELECT AVG(site_avg_faces) as overall_avg_faces FROM site_mesh_stats), filtered_sites AS (SELECT sms.site_avg_faces, sga.status_avg_faces FROM site_mesh_stats sms INNER JOIN status_group_averages sga ON sms.entrystat = sga.entrystat WHERE sms.site_avg_faces > sga.status_avg_faces) SELECT AVG(fs.site_avg_faces) as avg_face_count, AVG(fs.site_avg_faces) - oac.overall_avg_faces as above_overall_avg, AVG(fs.site_avg_faces - fs.status_avg_faces) as above_status_avg FROM filtered_sites fs CROSS JOIN overall_average_calc oac
